item.description: I’m constantly having to self-police everything I say... Is this going to be the thing that gets me on Fox News and gets my teaching certificate revoked? That's what Saoirse Stone, a trans teacher in Florida, told The Advocate's Christopher Wiggins this week. And it's one of many reasons why she's leaving Florida for Maryland as soon as she and her wife can save up the money.
